power.note: Predeclared 2026-11-02 before any game, after the red team of the served planner_unified_offer (it feeds near-winners, offers almost every turn, and its lift shrinks against strict acceptors). Control is the served planner_unified_offer (PR #18). Tables: tactical, mixed, self (three planner_unified_offer) and strict (three planner_strict_acceptor: planner_unified that accepts only for a hand-score gain >= .5 and only from a seat behind it on public points). planner_offer_guard and planner_offer_sparse share seed blocks 2450000/2451000/2452000/2453000. Guard: never offer to a seat with >= 8 public points; offer gain = own hand-score gain minus .5 x the recipient's next-turn build gain. NON-INFERIORITY screen: passes if every table's paired lift is at least -.03; the aim is safer, less predictable offers at no measurable strength cost. 320 seeds per table (four tables). Constants (8 points, .5 help weight, .5 margin, 3 turns) fixed before any game; a fail parks the arm, no retuning. A pass makes it eligible to replace the served offers (owner's decision); offer counts, accept rate and trades to >= 8-point seats are reported separately by scripts/offer_diagnostics.py.
